gh pr create --base main --title "docs: show the workflow log of a run with pit v0.39.0" --body "Follow-up to #91 for #90: update the docs to match the latest versions.

The example log in \\\`docs/how-it-works.md\\\` showed a run with an old pit: the model got \\\`read, write, edit, bash, typescript\\\`, and the calls were \\\`bash\\\` and \\\`edit\\\` calls. With pit v0.39.0 the model gets only \\\`typescript\\\`, the 🔧 line shows the label of each program, and the ↳ line shows the functions it used. The example now shows that.

The other version references in the docs are already current (pit v0.39.0, \\\`actions/checkout@v7\\\`, \\\`cv/pi-action@v2\\\`, pi 1.5.2), or are minimum versions for features (pit 0.36.x), or are the example of a pit before 0.36 (v0.35.1, the last such release).
